suite.name: quick
notes: Built in smoke suite for fast checks on small models.
Over refusal uses a keyword detector and is a coarse signal.
Standard benchmark suites arrive in a later release.

metrics.name: capability_accuracy
metrics.description: Accuracy on built in multiple choice items, scored by log likelihood.

metrics.name: over_refusal_rate
metrics.description: Share of benign prompts that the model refuses (keyword detector).

metrics.name: output_divergence_kl
metrics.description: Mean KL divergence of next token distributions on neutral text.
